BACKUP_APPLY_FAILED.hint: Nothing was changed. Your previous data is untouched.
BACKUP_APPLY_FAILED.title: Restore failed

BACKUP_ARCHIVE_INVALID.hint: The file was not saved because it could not be restored. Try again.
BACKUP_ARCHIVE_INVALID.title: The new backup failed verification

BACKUP_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH.hint: The checksum does not match. The file changed after it was created or was damaged in transfer.
BACKUP_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH.title: The backup is corrupted

BACKUP_COLLECT_FAILED.hint: Reload the page and try again.
BACKUP_COLLECT_FAILED.title: Your data could not be read

BACKUP_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Open Repo over HTTPS or localhost. Browsers disable secure hashing elsewhere.
BACKUP_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE.title: Checksums are not available

BACKUP_DECRYPT_FAILED.hint: Check the passphrase and make sure the backup file has not been changed or damaged.
BACKUP_DECRYPT_FAILED.title: The backup could not be decrypted

BACKUP_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.hint: Your browser blocked the download. Use Download again, or allow downloads for this site.
BACKUP_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.title: The file could not be saved

BACKUP_FILE_READ_FAILED.hint: Choose the file again, or copy it to this device first.
BACKUP_FILE_READ_FAILED.title: The file could not be read

BACKUP_FILE_TOO_LARGE.hint: Backups larger than 25 MB are rejected to protect your device.
BACKUP_FILE_TOO_LARGE.title: This file is too large

BACKUP_MANIFEST_INVALID.hint: The manifest is missing, unreadable or from another app.
BACKUP_MANIFEST_INVALID.title: This is not a readable Repo backup

BACKUP_MERGE_INVALID.hint: Merging would leave inconsistent data, so nothing was changed. See the technical details.
BACKUP_MERGE_INVALID.title: The chosen combination cannot be applied

BACKUP_NOT_ZIP.hint: Pick a .zip created by Repo. The file may be damaged or incomplete.
BACKUP_NOT_ZIP.title: This is not a valid ZIP archive

BACKUP_PACKAGE_FAILED.hint: Try again. If it keeps failing, reload the page.
BACKUP_PACKAGE_FAILED.title: The backup file could not be built

BACKUP_PASSWORD_REQUIRED.hint: Enter the passphrase that was used when this backup was created.
BACKUP_PASSWORD_REQUIRED.title: A passphrase is required

BACKUP_PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT.hint: Choose a passphrase with at least 8 characters.
BACKUP_PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT.title: The passphrase is too short

BACKUP_ROLLBACK_FAILED.hint: Restore the safety backup file that was downloaded before this step.
BACKUP_ROLLBACK_FAILED.title: Restore could not be completed or undone

BACKUP_SELFCHECK_FAILED.hint: The stored data has inconsistencies, so no backup was written. See the technical details.
BACKUP_SELFCHECK_FAILED.title: Your data failed the pre-backup check

BACKUP_SIZE_MISMATCH.hint: The data file size does not match its manifest. Download the backup again.
BACKUP_SIZE_MISMATCH.title: The backup is incomplete

BACKUP_STALE.hint: Nothing was restored. Start the restore again so the comparison is up to date.
BACKUP_STALE.title: Your data changed during the review

BACKUP_STRUCTURE_INVALID.hint: Some records break Repo's rules, so nothing was restored. See the technical details.
BACKUP_STRUCTURE_INVALID.title: The backup data is not valid

BACKUP_UNEXPECTED_CONTENT.hint: A Repo backup holds only manifest.json and data.json. This file was changed or is not a Repo backup.
BACKUP_UNEXPECTED_CONTENT.title: The archive has unexpected contents

BACKUP_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.title: This backup comes from a newer version

BACKUP_VERIFY_FAILED.hint: The restored data did not pass verification, so your previous data was put back.
BACKUP_VERIFY_FAILED.title: Restore was rolled back

DATA_INTEGRITY.hint: Create a backup now, then copy the diagnostics for details.
DATA_INTEGRITY.title: Some stored data looks inconsistent

LAST_BOARD.hint: Create another board first, then delete this one.
LAST_BOARD.title: You need at least one board

LAST_STAGE.hint: Add another stage first, then delete this one.
LAST_STAGE.title: A board needs at least one stage

LIMIT_REACHED.hint: Remove something you no longer need and try again.
LIMIT_REACHED.title: Limit reached

PREFS_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Your browser blocks small settings storage. Repo still works but forgets your last board.
PREFS_UNAVAILABLE.title: Preferences cannot be saved

RENDER_CRASH.hint: Your data is safe. Reload the page to continue.
RENDER_CRASH.title: This screen crashed

STORAGE_CLOSED.hint: Repo may be open in another tab that was updated. Reload this page.
STORAGE_CLOSED.title: Storage was closed

STORAGE_QUOTA.hint: Free up space or empty the trash, then try again.
STORAGE_QUOTA.title: This device is out of storage

STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Repo keeps your data in this browser. Allow site data, leave private browsing, then reload.
STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Local storage is unavailable

UNEXPECTED.hint: Your data is safe on this device. Try again, or reload the page if it keeps happening.
UNEXPECTED.title: Something unexpected happened

backups.body: A backup is a ZIP file saved to your device. It contains all of your notes and is not encrypted, so store it as carefully as the notes themselves. Checksums detect corruption but do not prove who made a file, so only restore backups you trust.
backups.title: Backups

card.summary: Your data stays on this device. Repo has no account, no tracking and no third-party requests.

changes.body: If this policy changes, the new version and its date will appear on this page.
changes.title: Changes

control.body: You can delete items, empty the trash, delete boards, or clear this site's data in your browser settings at any time. Clearing site data permanently removes everything Repo stored, so create a backup first if you want to keep it.
control.title: Your control

hosting.body: The site is served as static files through GitHub Pages. Like any web host, GitHub may keep standard technical logs of requests, such as IP address and time, under its own privacy statement. Repo itself cannot see or control those logs.
hosting.title: Hosting

privacy.intro: Repo is a personal workspace that runs entirely in your browser. This page explains what that means for your data.

limits.body: A browser may clear its storage when a device runs low on space, and storage is not shared between browsers or devices. Create backups regularly.
limits.title: Good to know

local.body: Boards, items, notes, the trash and your settings are saved in this browser's storage (IndexedDB and localStorage). Repo has no server, no account and no cloud database, so nothing you write is sent to us or to anyone else.
local.title: Your data stays on your device

terms.body: Repo is open source under the MIT License. It is provided as is, without warranty of any kind, and the authors are not liable for data loss or damage arising from its use.
terms.title: License and terms

privacy.title: Privacy & Policy

tracking.body: Repo does not use analytics, advertising, tracking cookies, or third-party scripts, fonts and images. The page only loads files from its own address.
tracking.title: No tracking

restore.confirmBody: From {name}: {added} added and {replaced} replaced. Everything else stays as it is.
restore.doneBody: The backup data you chose is now part of your workspace.
restore.drop: Drop a backup here or choose a file
restore.intro: Choose a backup ZIP created by Repo. It is fully checked and compared with your data before anything changes.
restore.passphraseHint: Leave blank for an unencrypted backup.
restore.replaceNote: Restoring never deletes existing data. New records are added, and records you choose to replace are overwritten. Everything is applied at once and undone automatically if verification fails.
